name: Exaforce
tagline: Agentic SOC platform that detects, triages, investigates, and responds to threats.
description: Exaforce runs an agentic security operations center built around AI agents it calls 'Exabots' that detect threats, cut alert noise, investigate incidents, and execute response actions with analyst oversight. It combines large language models with semantic, statistical, and behavioral models, and integrates with 100+ sources spanning SIEMs, cloud, identity, and SaaS. Available as a self-managed platform or a managed detection and response (MDR) service.
insight: Founded in 2023; raised a $75M Series A in 2025 then a $125M Series B in May 2026, ~$200M total.

modelSupport.notes: Pairs LLMs with semantic, statistical, and behavioral models for detection and triage.

edge: Multi-model Exabots span the full SOC loop — detect, triage, investigate, respond — rather than bolting AI onto a single alert-triage step.
pros: Covers detection through response, not just triage
Offered as platform or managed MDR service
cons: Enterprise sales, no public pricing or self-serve
Aimed at security teams, not individuals

references.title: Exaforce raises $125M Series B to build AI for catching cyberattacks
Exaforce Banks Hefty $75 Million for AI-Powered SOC Remake
